title: Five-sphere implementation and cost evidence — 15 distinct measurements

observations.limitation: National physical exports, not Europe-only volumes, FOB value, profit or sanction-driven benefit.
DFC-client-reported impact, not independently audited or necessarily newly built capacity; do not attribute all output to 2025 disbursements.

observations.metric: Transmission lines constructed or improved by DFC-supported clients
observations.limitation: Constructed or improved is a combined category; not exclusively new transmission or proof of DFC causality.

observations.metric: European Commission exceptional MFA ERA loans disbursed to Ukraine year-to-date
observations.limitation: Cumulative EU ERA loan payments; do not add interim tranches to cumulative total or confuse loans with Russian principal confiscation.

observations.metric: Windfall profits from immobilised Russian central-bank assets disposition
observations.limitation: €4.2bn includes reserved sums; €8bn aggregate is not all cash received by Ukraine and does not represent seized principal. Timing is as-of source retrieval, not annual.
All suppliers and both LNG and pipeline; rising imports do not prove Russian replacement cost or influence.

observations.metric: EU LNG regasification import capacity year-on-year growth
observations.limitation: Capacity increase is not utilization, import volume or return on investment; project-level capital costs not provided.

observations.metric: China-Laos Railway actual cross-border freight transported
observations.limitation: Railway operator figures relayed by Chinese state media; not independently audited, not the railway's total domestic-plus-international cargo or net Laos fiscal gain.
Reported by operator KCIC via Indonesian ANTARA; ridership is a delivered service, not profitability or evidence of Indonesian policy alignment.

observations.metric: Announced annual debt-service installment under Indonesian Whoosh restructuring plan
observations.limitation: Announced debt restructuring terms, not a verified executed loan amendment or actual annual payment; tenor does not establish lifetime net present cost.

observations.metric: CREA-modeled Russian worldwide fossil-fuel export gross revenues in fourth year of full-scale invasion
observations.limitation: War-anniversary period, not calendar 2025; modeled gross revenue, not audited cash receipts, tax income or sanction-causal decline.

observations.metric: CREA-modeled Russian crude oil export gross revenue and volume in fourth war year
observations.limitation: Crude subset of preceding fossil total; never add EUR 85.5bn to EUR 193bn. Modeled, not audited.

observations.metric: First Russia-DPRK cross-border road bridge inaugurated
observations.limitation: Inauguration and reported initial cargo traffic are not verified crossing counts, military shipments, actual utilization or economic benefit.

observations.metric: Reported international UPI transactions in first four months of Indian FY2025-26
observations.limitation: Secondary report of Lok Sabha answer; needs direct parliamentary primary-document retrieval before independent audit gate. Cross-border UPI does not measure Indian diplomatic influence.

observations.metric: US-India goods trade and US goods trade deficit
observations.limitation: Goods only, not services; a trade deficit is not national welfare or a geopolitical score. No causal attribution to 2025-26 trade negotiations.

nonAdditivity: EU ERA loans and immobilised-asset windfall allocations are different financial instruments; do not sum as an unqualified EU contribution.
Russian crude revenues are a subset of Russian total fossil-fuel revenues.
US LNG export volumes and EU gas imports differ in geographic scope and source; do not treat one as destination invoices.
China-Laos railway freight and Whoosh passengers are separate projects and units.
DFC 2025 client output and line-construction figures are self-reported aggregates, not independently verified DFC-only incremental outcomes.
remainingGaps: Project-level audited spending and cash disbursements
Recipient-side operating records for self-reported infrastructure results
Cost incidence, especially Indonesian Whoosh debt and EU gas substitution
Counterfactual comparisons for each geopolitical actor
Causal identification before audit gate promotion
